# Utiliy

> AI product page optimizer for ecommerce — audits live Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, and marketplace PDPs for Google SEO, schema, keywords, images, and AI shopping visibility.

Utiliy is operated by Fix Figures LLC. The public site includes an AI optimization lab, open research benchmarks, and the Utiliy Product Readiness Specification (UPRS).

## Product

- [AI Product Page Optimizer](https://utiliy.com/): Paste a product URL for a free six-pillar audit and copy-paste fixes
- [Pricing](https://utiliy.com/pricing/): Free tier plus Pro at $24/month

## Research & standards

- [Utiliy Product Page Index (Q1 2026)](https://utiliy.com/pdp-index/): Live PDP benchmark across Amazon, Best Buy, eBay, Etsy, and Shopify DTC
- [PDP Index methodology](https://utiliy.com/pdp-index/methodology/): Sample selection, scoring model, limitations
- [UPRS specification](https://utiliy.com/spec/uprs/): Open rule IDs for product page readiness audits
- [PDP readiness badge embed](https://utiliy.com/embed/badge/): Embed verified audit scores on merchant sites
